title: Asynchronous programming (async and await)
summary: C# async is a language transformation over Task and ValueTask: you write sequential statements, the compiler builds a state machine, and I/O completions resume you without occupying a thread. This module stays on the Task-based Asynchronous Pattern (TAP), exceptions, cancellation, ConfigureAwait, and IAsyncEnumerable — not thread-pool internals.
